subject.title: fix(publication): keep current review results moving during historical cleanup

question: Should production publication batches reserve two of eight positions for authoritative results created within 15 minutes, or should maintainers choose a different fairness allocation before this scheduler policy ships?
rationale: The patch preserves existing safety fences and provides a rollback flag, but the chosen ratio and time window intentionally trade some historical FIFO latency for bounded current-result service; that is an operational product decision rather than a mechanical correctness question.

options.title: Keep the proposed policy
options.body: Approve the two-of-eight, 15-minute reserve and merge with a post-deployment observation gate for current-result latency and historical drain.

options.title: Adjust the policy before landing
options.body: Keep the same admission design but request a different reserve size or recency window based on the desired backlog-versus-freshness tradeoff.

options.title: Defer fairness admission
options.body: Leave the PR draft until maintainers want to change publication ordering beyond existing capacity and cleanup work.

recommendation.title: Keep the proposed policy
recommendation.body: Approve the two-of-eight, 15-minute reserve and merge with a post-deployment observation gate for current-result latency and historical drain.

likelyOwner.reason: The open single-writer RFC and merged publication-lineage work place this policy choice closest to their established queue architecture context.
